role: fresh external one-year anti-overfit transfer test

outcome_source.date_rule: date_start determines event state-week; target scoring requires date_start in calendar 2014
outcome_source.preperiod_rule: calendar 2013 matching events may identify initial geographic anchors only

case_construction.locality_coordinate: population-weighted state centroid from WorldPop cells
case_construction.state_population: sum WorldPop 2014 cells within GADM state polygon
case_construction.adjacency: GADM polygon boundary intersection/touch; disconnected artifacts bridged only by shortest polygon distance and explicitly reported
case_construction.neutral_covariate_rule: No 2014 violence outcome may set any environmental covariate.

initialization.insurgent_anchor_rule: top five states by matching 2013 UCDP state-based event count, ties by state ID
initialization.strength_role: initialization uncertainty strata, not fitted values

acceptance.proper_score_rule: Pineland must strictly beat the best 2013-trained competitor on both mean Brier loss and mean log score over every 2014 state-week cell.
acceptance.strength_robustness: Each four-seed strength stratum must beat global_rate on at least one proper score and may be worse by no more than 0.002 Brier or 0.01 mean log score on the other.

interpretation.pass: Fresh external one-year empirical support against declared simple competitors; evidence against Afghanistan-specific outcome overfitting. Not proof of a universal theory.
interpretation.fail: Preserve failure; Nigeria 2014 becomes consumed and may not be used for tuning followed by re-testing on the same target.
